name: Cook's Diff
tagline: See exactly how real cooks changed the recipe.
description: Cook's Diff reads every review on a recipe and turns the changes home cooks actually made into a clear, color-coded diff: what they added, removed and swapped. Paste a recipe link and compare the original with each community tweak.

faq.q: How do I see what people changed in a recipe?
faq.a: Paste the recipe's link into Cook's Diff. It reads the reviews, pulls out every concrete change cooks made (less sugar, extra garlic, a different pan) and shows each one as a tweak you can switch to, highlighted line by line against the original recipe.
Green lines were added by the cook, red lines were removed, yellow lines were changed, and blue notes are general tips that don't map to a single line.

faq.q: Which recipe sites does it work with?
faq.a: Allrecipes recipe pages work today, including their featured tweaks. Support for more recipe sites that publish reviews is being added.

faq.q: Is Cook's Diff free? Do I need an account?
faq.a: It's free and there's no account or sign-up. Paste a link and cook.

faq.q: Is Cook's Diff affiliated with Allrecipes?
faq.a: No. Cook's Diff is an independent tool. It links back to the original recipe so you can always read it at the source.

An AI model reads each review and extracts the changes, then every change is checked against the real recipe lines. Changes that don't match a real line are dropped, and reviews without a concrete change show up as notes.
